reviewItem.question: Does "Storage version of `ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws` changes v1beta1 → v1" mean a change to migration:karpenter|name=ec2nodeclasses-storage-version-upgrade-v1beta1-to-v1 (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: A storage version migration of EC2NodeClass from v1beta1 to v1 is required; existing objects remain in v1beta1 storage until explicitly migrated, and v1beta1 will be removed in a later release.
